mainEntity.name: What types of living room additions can I consider?

acceptedAnswer.text: Living room additions typically involve expanding the existing space or creating a new one. Common options include adding square footage for a larger family room, building an entirely new living area like a sunroom or great room, or converting existing unused space such as a garage. The best choice depends on your home's layout, local zoning regulations in areas like Alameda or Berkeley, and your specific needs for space and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can expand existing space, build a new room like a sunroom, or convert unused areas like a garage. Your choice depends on your home, local regulations, and functional needs.
